hotels.title: Thailand Grand Opening: Ao Nang Beach Escape with Daily Breakfast, Daily Cocktails & Nightly Dinner
hotels.description: Be among the first lucky travellers to enjoy a new world of relaxation at this recently revealed Grand Mercure. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Ao Nang, enjoy easy access to the area's vibrant night markets, restaurants and entertainment, all while just a short stroll from Ao Nang Beach to savour the best of Krabi's coastline. Two pools, a poolside bar, panoramic views and a fitness centre fill the moments between exploration. Chill Kitchen handles all-day dining with Thai classics and international dishes, while Da Vino Trattoria brings handmade pasta and wood-fired pizzas to the table for evenings with a distinctly Italian character. Families are well catered for with a dedicated Kids' Club and kids' pool, while the resort's location near Nopparat Thara Pier makes for easy day trips to Railay Beach, the popular Four Islands route, or the Phi Phi Islands further afield.
